ids.statement: Skill resolution is deterministic: project, personal, then bundled, with the first unique name winning.
Baseline artifacts are byte-deterministic and every fixture is explicitly classified.
Mission closeout follows a successful terminal review or an explicit acknowledged-gap transition.
Role configuration is explicit and invalid bounded values fail instead of being silently broadened.
Authored task order is deterministic, work selects singly before persistence, and only validator-only batches may run concurrently.
Every covering upstream validator must pass every gate target; missing evidence and dissent fail.
Protected path-category resolution, schema generation, and diagnostics are deterministic.
Orchestrator, worker, and terminal-reviewer MCP modes register disjoint tool sets.
One read-only command deterministically validates repository identity, references, governance, schemas, generated output, and its own CI enforcement.
One coordinator step performs at most one externally visible state transition.
Durable mission records and orchestrator-only runtime cursors remain in separate roots.
Every live contract assertion has exactly one non-superseded work owner.
Normal text and JSON persistence uses a sibling temporary file followed by atomic replacement.
The public envelope retains the dag field name for its textual task-list view.
Supersede and cancel rewrite direct dependency edges while decision records preserve audit rationale.
Schema readers use explicit versions with tested compatibility or an explicit hard cut and recovery path.
Worker and terminal-reviewer servers do not register orchestrator lifecycle tools.
Agents and providers cannot satisfy accountable review or approve protected promotion.
Terminal-review deliverable roots resolve only inside the workspace product surface or current mission evidence.
